name: Desi Tamatar (Tomatoes)
description: Locally grown desi tomatoes, favored for their tartness in curries and chutneys.
storageTip: Store at room temperature stem-side down away from direct sunlight; do not refrigerate until fully ripe.
nutritionalHighlight: High in Lycopene and Vitamin C

name: Genda Phool (Marigold)
description: Marigold garlands and loose flowers, sourced from local flower growers for home, festival, and event use.
storageTip: Keep stems trimmed in cold water in a cool spot; mist lightly to keep petals from wilting.

name: Desi Anda (Farm Eggs)
description: Free-range desi eggs from small poultry farms within the region.
storageTip: Keep refrigerated in their carton pointy-end down to preserve freshness for up to 3 weeks.

name: Desi Shehad (Honey)
description: Unfiltered honey harvested from apiaries in the northern regions of Pakistan.
storageTip: Store in an airtight glass jar in a dry, dark cupboard. Do not refrigerate (natural crystallization is normal).
nutritionalHighlight: Raw enzymes, antioxidants, and natural pollen

name: Desi Dahi (Fresh Yogurt)
description: Thick, fresh dahi (yogurt) set daily in clay matkas from a single regional dairy farm.
storageTip: Keep the clay matka dahi in the coldest part of the fridge, covered, to slow further fermentation.
nutritionalHighlight: Probiotics, high calcium, and gut-friendly cultures

name: Garlic Naan
description: Fresh garlic naan, brushed with herbs and butter, baked in a clay tandoor the morning of market day.
storageTip: Wrap tightly in a clean cotton kitchen cloth immediately after baking to keep soft and warm.

name: Sabut Masale (Whole & Ground Spices)
description: Whole coriander seed, black peppercorns, turmeric, and red chili powder, ground fresh to order at the stall.
storageTip: Store in an airtight jar away from direct sunlight to preserve color and aroma.
culinaryUses: Base masala for daal and curries
nutritionalHighlight: Rich in antioxidants and digestive compounds from whole spices

name: Chaunsa & Sindhri Aam (Mangoes)
description: Chaunsa and Sindhri mangoes sourced directly from Multan and Sindh orchards.
storageTip: Keep at room temperature until fragrant and slightly soft to the touch, then chill 1 hour before serving.
nutritionalHighlight: High Vitamin A, Vitamin C, and dietary fiber

name: Sarson & Til ka Tel
description: Cold-pressed mustard (sarson) and sesame (til) oil, pressed in small batches with no additives.
storageTip: Store in dark amber glass bottles away from stove heat and sunlight to prevent oxidation.
nutritionalHighlight: Rich in monosaturated fats and Omega-6
